target_customer: Merchants who send itemized digital receipts to business buyers, and finance teams that need receipts in expense systems
problem: Business buyers must collect receipts for tax and expense compliance, which is manual, and merchants face disputes and chargebacks.
business_model: Free to buyers at launch per the YC post; merchant-side monetization not stated. Later hotel invoice reconciliation product.
product_category: Smart receipts network, later AI hotel invoice reconciliation

founders.name: Ted Power
previous_startups: Abacus (co-founder, YC W14, acquired per YC page)

founders.name: Thomas Moore
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an engineer at Abacus.

competitors.name: Brex
competitors.what: Corporate card and expense management that the launch post calls strong on everything except receipts

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires integrations with payment processors such as Stripe and with expense systems, and matching receipts to transactions.

defensibility.rationale: A merchant-owned network could gain from adoption on both sides, but it needed a critical mass of merchants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented; the company later shifted its website to hotel invoice reconciliation.

market_need_then: The launch post cites IRS receipt requirements for transactions over 75 dollars and European VAT reclaim rules as the compliance pain.

brand_strength.rationale: Many companies use the name Versa and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Merchant-owned network for smart B2B receipts
pivots.to: Versa Direct, AI hotel invoice reconciliation
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the current website versus the YC launch post.

outcome_analysis: Versa started as a merchant-owned receipt network and its website now sells hotel invoice reconciliation with a SOC 2 badge, which suggests a narrower pivot. No funding, traction or outcome data was found, so the company's progress is unknown beyond still having a live site.
notes: No funding information found in any source; unknown is not zero. Team size on directory is 2. Brex is described in the launch post as adjacent, not a direct rival. Searches for dated 2022 competitors returned only recent vendor pages.
